doc.name: ctxstore
doc.description: Persistent memory for AI agents over MCP. Store keyed facts, search them, and get a compiled wake bundle of identity, conventions and current state on every connect, so one memory follows the agent across models and clients.

bearer.description: API key from https://ctxstore.ai (emk_...) sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.1 with discovery at /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server; protected resource metadata at https://mcp.ctxstore.ai/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp.

skills.name: Store a fact
skills.description: Store a fact. Tag by category. Decays by default unless is_permanent=true.
examples: Remember that deploys go to staging first and prod only on my word.

skills.name: Search facts
skills.description: Search stored facts, preferences, and decisions by category, namespace, or layer.
examples: What did we decide about the release cadence?

skills.name: Load layered context
skills.description: Load full layered context at session start (L0 identity + L1 arch + L2 state + L3 session).
examples: Start the session with everything you know about this project.

skills.name: Resume the last session
skills.description: Narrative summary of last session. Call at start of new session to continue where you left off.
examples: Where did we leave off yesterday?

skills.name: Store a session summary
skills.description: Save session summary before ending. Dream cycle: next session auto-loads it.
examples: Save a summary of what we did today before I close this.

skills.name: Search conversations
skills.description: Semantic search over ingested conversations with temporal weighting.
examples: Find the conversation where we compared the two vector stores.

skills.name: Fact history
skills.description: Full version history for a keyed fact: current plus all deprecated predecessors.
examples: Show every version of the pricing decision.

skills.name: Ghost mode
skills.description: Privacy switch. Reads work normally; writes silently skip until toggled off.
examples: Do not remember anything from this next conversation.

skills.name: Session seed
skills.description: Pre-computed first-person bio (about 500 tokens). Generated nightly and at session end.
examples: Give me the short version of who I am to you.

skills.name: Usage stats
skills.description: Usage stats, collection sizes, vectors stored, plan limits.
examples: How much memory am I using and what is my plan limit?

skills.name: Forget a fact
skills.description: Soft-delete a fact (Smart Forget). Preserved in DB for audit.

skills.name: Move a fact
skills.description: Move a fact to a different namespace or layer without changing content.
examples: Move that decision from the session layer to the architecture layer.

skills.name: Set up an account
skills.description: Create or restore your memory account via email OTP or API key.
examples: Create my memory account with my email.

skills.name: Context packs
skills.description: Browse starter fact templates by role (python-senior, startup-founder, etc.).
examples: Show me starter memory templates for a startup founder.

additionalInterfaces.description: 24-hour keyless trial, when enabled: connect with no key, store facts, claim the account by email to keep them.

plans.collaboration: $19 per person per month, 7 days free when invited
